subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `agents.entries.*.modelSpend` as a supported core configuration and durable per-agent billing-alert contract?
rationale: The branch appears to implement the requested behavior and includes meaningful runtime proof, but no maintainer decision establishes whether proactive per-agent cost accounting, provider-cost fallback semantics, and owner-DM delivery belong in the core product or what compatibility policy should govern them.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
options.body: Accept this capability in principle, then require a maintainer-approved definition of billing semantics, upgrade behavior, storage lifecycle, and privacy guarantees before merge.

options.title: Route it outside core
options.body: Decline the new core configuration and direct the implementation toward an external plugin or operational integration if its required hooks can be provided without embedding policy in core.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the PR open as a draft while a maintainer decides whether proactive spend alerts are a current product priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Accept this capability in principle, then require a maintainer-approved definition of billing semantics, upgrade behavior, storage lifecycle, and privacy guarantees before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-boundary and public configuration decision rather than a mechanical code repair.
